name: TEAtime Starter
description: A low-code website starter using the TEA stack: Tailwind CSS 4 (CSS-first config), Eleventy 3 and Alpine.js. Includes image optimisation, SEO meta tags, dynamic sitemap and robots.txt, HTML/CSS minification, one-click Netlify deploy and an AGENTS.md guide for AI coding agents.
author: alanmosely
